product_overview: Magicpie Fees Calculator is a web app for the Magicpie band (Gege, Ical, Bayu, Dendi, Boim) to manage gig income, calculate production deductions, and split net fees across the band. Managers record each gig's contract fee, assign members and crew, add production and operational expenses, and the app computes the net band fee with payout tracking, PDF/Excel export, itinerary templates, and a full audit log. Access is closed: no public signup and no invites; five pre-created accounts are the only way in and all admins share one workspace.
core_goals: Sign in with email and password (pre-created admin accounts only)
Create, update, review, and export gig fee settlements
Manage members, crew, production roles, and per-gig expenses
View personal payout summaries (members) and app settings with audit log

features.name: User Login
features.description: Users sign in with email and password to access the app. Only the five pre-created accounts can log in; Google and invite flows were removed.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an authentication error message

features.name: First Admin Setup
features.description: When no users exist, the first admin can create the initial account (gated by ADMIN_SETUP_CODE). Once any user exists, signup is blocked.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill in name, email, and password -> Submit the admin setup form -> See the dashboard

features.name: Shared Workspace
features.description: All admins operate on one shared workspace owned by the superadmin (Gege). Gigs, members, crew, settings, production roles, and audit logs are band-wide.
user_flows: Sign in as any admin -> See the same gigs, members, and crew as the workspace owner
Sign in as a member -> Be redirected to /me only

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Admins review overall gig performance and recent gig activity.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View gig stats and recent gigs -> Open a gig detail
Navigate to / -> Review the dashboard summary -> Select a gig from recent activity -> See gig details

features.name: Gig Management
features.description: Admins create, edit, organize, and review gigs with fee settlement details, statuses, and PDF/Excel exports. Default gig type is Festival.
user_flows: Navigate to /gigs -> Create a new gig -> Fill in event details, client, venue, city, date, gig type (default Festival), and total fee -> Add members, crew, and expenses -> Save the gig -> See the gig appear in the list with its status badge
Navigate to /gigs -> Open a gig detail -> Review the settlement breakdown -> Change the gig status
Navigate to /gigs -> Open a gig detail -> Export the gig as PDF or Excel -> Save the exported report
Navigate to /gigs -> Open a gig detail -> Delete the gig after confirming the action -> See the gig removed from the list
Navigate to /gigs -> Open a gig detail -> Edit gig information -> Save the changes -> See the updated gig details

features.name: Itinerary Templates
features.description: Admins save reusable itinerary templates (local / out-of-town) and manage template records.
user_flows: Navigate to /itinerary -> View the itinerary template list
Navigate to /itinerary -> Create a new template -> Save the template -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /itinerary -> Delete a template -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Masters Management
features.description: Admins manage members, crew, and production role presets used across gigs.
user_flows: Navigate to /masters -> View the members and crew lists
Navigate to /masters -> Add a new member or crew entry -> Save the entry -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /masters -> Edit an existing member or crew entry -> Save the changes -> See the updated entry
Navigate to /masters -> Delete a member or crew entry -> Confirm the deletion -> See the entry removed
Navigate to /masters -> Manage production roles -> Save a production role preset -> See it available for use in the gig expense picker

features.name: Member Dashboard
features.description: Member accounts (and admins with a linked member) can view their own payout summary and per-gig earnings. Members only see /me.
user_flows: Navigate to /me -> View own payout summary and per-gig earnings
Navigate to /me -> Review the payout breakdown -> Compare earnings across gigs

features.name: Settings
features.description: Admins update app defaults (crew fee bounds, meal rate and cutoff), manage production roles, and review audit logs. Invites were removed.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Edit crew defaults or meal settings -> Save the settings -> See the updated values persist
Navigate to /settings -> View audit log entries -> Review recent activity
Navigate to /settings -> Manage production roles -> Add/edit/delete a role preset

tech_stack: Drizzle ORM + libsql (Turso hosted DB in production; local SQLite fallback)

known_limitations.issue: No public signup and no invites; access is limited to five pre-created accounts
known_limitations.impact: Adding a new manager requires a manual DB insert and setupAdminAction

known_limitations.issue: Database is Turso hosted libSQL; local development falls back to a local SQLite file (magicpie.db)
known_limitations.impact: Local data is separate from production data; schema changes must be pushed to Turso

known_limitations.issue: better-auth requires BETTER_AUTH_SECRET in production; missing env vars cause 500s on all auth routes
known_limitations.impact: Auth env vars must be set on Vercel (BETTER_AUTH_URL, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, TURSO_DATABASE_URL, TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN)
